one_line: Art historian of Khajuraho, interpreting its temple imagery and puruṣārtha vision for modern audiences.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, medium height, slight but sturdy build with an active scholar’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, soft jawline, gentle smile lines, sharp observant eyes behind thin-rimmed rectangular glasses, default expression calm, thoughtful and slightly curious.
appearance.hair: Smooth dark grey-black hair parted slightly to the side, drawn back into a low bun at the nape, a few soft wisps at the temples, no headscarf, only a small understated silver hairpin at the bun.
appearance.costume: Era-modern but India-classic academic: a handloom cotton sari in muted teal blue with a narrow maroon border and subtle thin gold stripes, worn in a simple Nivi drape that covers her torso fully, the pallu neatly brought over the left shoulder and hanging to mid-calf; beneath it a short-sleeved maroon blouse fully covered by the sari; she wears comfortable flat brown leather sandals, a thin silver wristwatch on her left wrist, small round silver stud earrings and a simple black-threaded pendant with a tiny silver disk, plus a practical canvas crossbody satchel in sand-beige slung from right shoulder to left hip, slightly worn at the edges.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized, slightly weathered sketchbook held in her left hand, its off-white cover marked with a light pencil outline of a Khajuraho temple tower, and a slim mechanical pencil tucked into the top spiral binding.

ref_desc: Devangana Desai is a late-middle-aged, medium-brown woman with oval face, glasses, dark grey-black hair in a low bun, wearing a teal sari with maroon border, maroon blouse, brown sandals, silver watch, beige crossbody satchel, and holding a sketchbook with temple outlines.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Devangana Desai: a late-40s to early-50s medium-brown Indian woman with an oval face, intelligent eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, and dark grey-black hair parted slightly off-center and tied in a low bun with a small silver hairpin and a few soft wisps at her temples; she wears a handloom cotton sari in muted teal blue with a narrow maroon border and subtle thin gold stripes, draped in a simple Nivi style that fully covers her torso and flows to her ankles, the pallu neatly over her left shoulder, over a short-sleeved maroon blouse that stays mostly hidden beneath the sari, and flat brown leather sandals; add small round silver stud earrings, a thin silver wristwatch on her left wrist, a simple black-thread necklace with a tiny silver disk pendant, and a practical sand-beige canvas crossbody satchel slung from right shoulder to left hip, slightly worn at the edges; her signature prop is a medium-sized off-white sketchbook with a faint pencil outline of a Khajuraho temple tower on the cover, held gently in her left hand with a slim mechanical pencil tucked into the top spiral; show front, side, and three-quarter poses with consistent teal, maroon, beige, and silver-grey colors, calm thoughtful expressions, and an overall scholarly, dignified presence.
